  "hints_text": "<!-- Greeting -->\nHi @cpu-16! I'm [Dosu](https://go.dosu.dev/dosubot) and I’m helping the langflow team.\n\n<!-- Answer -->\nThis happens because LangFlow always includes `\"mirostat\": 0` in the parameters sent to the Ollama API when Mirostat is set to \"Disabled\". Ollama expects the `mirostat` parameter to be omitted entirely when not in use—sending it with a value of 0 causes an invalid option error. The same applies to related parameters like `mirostat_eta` and `mirostat_tau` when Mirostat is disabled.\n\nTo fix this, the parameter-building logic in LangFlow's Ollama integration (specifically the `build_model` method) should only include `mirostat`, `mirostat_eta`, and `mirostat_tau` when Mirostat is enabled (i.e., not \"Disabled\" or 0). Right now, only parameters set to `None` are omitted, but parameters set to 0 are still sent, which is not compatible with Ollama's API requirements. This is a localized, low-risk change in the backend code and will resolve the integration error you’re seeing [reference](https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/blob/15f44519af6a414299d74516aa69f4c895235b69/src/backend/base/langflow/components/languagemodels/ollama.py).\n\nThere’s currently no documentation or open issues in the repo that address this parameter handling for Ollama models.
